features: Resolved a critical bug in the calculation of the installment plan total: in some scenarios, when the chart of accounts structure was populated by automatic migration (v1.9 beta 25 or 27) after the installment plan was created, the quota calculation engine erroneously excluded entire expense chapters (e.g., 'Routine Maintenance') and calculated installments on an amount lower than due. The cause was a 'time snapshot' filter that, finding no sub-accounts created before the installment plan, silently skipped the parent chapter instead of using the available children. The amount in the pivot table was already correct and frozen; the system now uses it correctly even when all sub-accounts are found to be subsequent to the plan's creation date.

Optimized queries in the installment calculation engine (ordinary): the millesimal tables of sub-accounts are now loaded in advance in a single operation instead of being retrieved individually for each expense item during calculation. This avoids a potential slowdown proportional to the number of items and ensures compatibility with Laravel versions that do not allow 'lazy' data loading.

Added emergency behavior in quota allocation: if a parent chapter contains sub-accounts with zero budget (a rare case but possible with manually created structures), the amount is now distributed equally among the children instead of being silently ignored, always ensuring accounting balance.

Strengthened the 'Orphan Chapters Synchronization' function: previously, new chapters added via manual synchronization were associated with the installment plan without freezing their amount, making them subject to future budget variations. From now on, the amount is calculated and saved at the exact moment of synchronization (snapshot), ensuring the historical consistency of the installment plan even in the event of subsequent budget changes.
